title: Isolation of vessel-associated _pdgfra_-H2BGFP positive cells from murine brain
protocol: Resuspend the Dynabeads® by vortexing for more than 30 seconds or tilting and rotating for 5 minutes.
Transfer 50 µL of Dynabeads® per brain to an Eppendorf tube.
Add 1 ml of PBS with 1% BSA and 2 mM EDTA, resuspend.
Place the tube in a magnet for 1 minute and discard the supernatant.
Remove the tube from the magnet and resuspend the washed Dynabeads® in 50 µL washing medium per brain.
Add 10 μL of 0.5 mg/µl CD31 antibodies per brain.
Incubate overnight at 4°C or for 1 hour at RT with gentle tilting and rotation.
Place the tube in a magnet for 1 minute and discard the supernatant.
Remove the tube from the magnet and add 1 ml washing medium.
Place the tube in the magnet for 1 minute, discard the supernatant, remove the tube from the magnet, and resuspend the Dynabeads® in 50 µL washing medium per brain.
Kill the mouse using an approved method of euthanasia.
Remove the brain from the skull.
Transfer the brain to a Petri dish and chop it with sharp scissors for about 30 seconds.
Dissolve 3 mg of collagenase powder in 3 ml of DMEM.
Transfer the chopped brain pieces to a 5 ml tube.
Mix the brain pieces with the collagenase solution using a p1000 pipette tip cut at the end.
Incubate the suspension for 5 minutes at 37 °C with rotation (15 rotations per minute).
Pass the suspension 10 times through an uncut p1000 tip.
Incubate the suspension for another 5 minutes at 37 °C with same rotation.
Wash the tissue suspension with 12 ml of DMEM (room temperature).
Centrifuge the solution at room temperature, 5 minutes at 300g.
Resuspend the pellet in 4.5 ml of DMEM and divide into three Eppendorf tubes of approximately 1.7 ml each.
Add 15 µL of the antibody+beads solution to each Eppendorf tube.
Pipette up and down several times to homogenize the mixture thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes with gentle rotation.
Place the three aliquots on the magnet and wait 2.5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 2 ml of DMEM to the beads, remove the tubes from the magnet, and resuspend the beads by gently tilting the tubes end-over-end until the beads are resuspended.
Repeat steps placing the aliquots on the magnet for 2.5 minutes, removing the supernatant, and resuspending the beads in DMEM.
Pool the three tubes by resuspending the first pellet in 1.5 ml of DMEM and using this to resuspend the pellets of the second and third aliquot.
Take 30 µl from the suspension and place a drop on a p100 Petri dish for microscopic verification.
Place the tubes on the magnet, wait 2.5 minutes, and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 1 ml of Collagenase single cell digestion buffer (3 mg/ml collagenase type 2 in DMEM) and incubate at 37 °C with rotation for 5 minutes.
Pass the suspension firmly through a 20 G needle using a 1 ml syringe, without creating bubbles or foam, for 10 times.
Incubate the single cell suspension for 5 minutes at 37°C.
Remove the beads by placing the suspension on the magnet for 2.5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant containing the cells.
Centrifuge the cells at 300g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μl of FACS buffer.
